title: Dreams of the baker and the butler
summary: Joseph interprets the dreams of Pharaoh’s butler and baker (Gen 40).
description: Joseph interprets the dreams of Pharaoh’s butler and baker (Gen 40). The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1717 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.date: 2286 1717 Dreams of the Baker and Butler
chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 278 (PDF p. 313)
chronologies.note: CONFLICT: Jones prints AM 2286 and 1717 BC. A derived check (not stored): 2286 + 1717 = 4003, not 4004, against his rule that a BC number added to its AM counterpart yields 4004. Both figures are stored as printed (first-printed rule). Neither was adjusted. The sort uses the printed BC year.
